STEP 7 CLASS REVIEW + construct sweep.

ENUMERATED 9 SITES (this ticket's committed scope) — all addressed:
- FIXED (8): _execute.py dispatcher (->None discover); transition.py:275 (->str(config.repo_root(repo_root)), fixes AC#1 gate + transitively close_ticket blame/scratch/compaction); transition.py:690 _unarchive; compact_trigger.py:107 ticket_needs_folding (threads repo_root) + :246 maybe_compact fallback (drops dirname); delete.py:390 scratch cleanup; validate.py:121 (config.repo_root_or_none()); _lib_gates.py:53 clarity threshold.
- DEFERRED (1): compact_trigger.py:213 run_sweep (detached child, cwd IS the store; needs a spawn-contract change) -> follow-up scathing-custommade-bobcat (6bf1-326b-7404-4034), sanctioned '# repo-root-ok:' so the AC#4 guard passes with exactly one allowlisted site.

BROADER CLASS FOUND (NOT in the enumerated 9) -> split to follow-up injurious-pugnacious-azurevase (c0f6-0fc9-fe48-41bc):
- composer.py:274/:286 + composer_edit.py:141: cfg_root=os.path.dirname(str(tracker)) feeding description_cap_warning/duplicate_create_warning (compose_config + _plan_review_gate_applies). Same class, ADVISORY-only (never blocks a write). Clean but str()-wrapped, so the AC#4 guard (bare-form scope) does not catch it.
- reads.py:238/:249/:374: dirname(realpath/abspath(tracker)) feeding compose_config sync.pull / tickets.branch / scratch.base_dir. NUANCED — these run 'git -C tracker_abs' on the STORE's OWN repo, so the tracker's parent may be the CORRECT root for sync/branch (AC#3's 'documents why' clause); resolving each needs a per-site design judgment, which is why it is split out rather than folded into this behavior-preserving change.

Kept THIS change to the committed 9 + the AC#4 guard (scoped to the bare os.path.dirname(tracker)/tracker_dir() form, exactly AC#4's wording) + RED->GREEN tests, mirroring the chuffy-arbored-goldfish scope-split discipline. The follow-up owns the str()/realpath()/abspath() variants AND the guard extension together.

VALIDATION: RED->GREEN + mutation confirmed (restoring dirname(tracker) at transition.py:275 -> AC#1 DID NOT RAISE; at _lib_gates.py -> clarity threshold 5!=9). make lint + make typecheck green; 776 affected-area unit tests pass.
